text: Let's cover the engine underneath Autoloader itself — structured streaming basics.

The core idea: treat a continuously arriving source as a table that just keeps growing, one micro batch at a time. This isn't a different API — it's the exact same DataFrame concept from Foundations' Chapter 4, just fed continuously instead of once.
Read stream instead of read is structurally almost the whole difference. Filter works exactly the same on a streaming DataFrame as a batch one — nearly everything you already know still applies.

Triggers control how often the stream checks. Processing time runs forever, on a fixed interval — a genuine always-on pipeline. Available now processes what's there right now, once, then stops — exactly what fits a scheduled job.
Almost everything from Foundations still works — checkpoints and triggers are really the only genuinely new pieces. Next lesson: streaming from bronze to silver, putting this to real use.
